source_population: Home Credit application_test.csv with frozen CrediFast artifacts

profiles.label: Strong · complete evidence
profiles.description: Low estimated risk with four historical source families.
profiles.demo_intent: Show the standard evidence-rich review route.

profiles.label: Boundary · human judgement
profiles.description: A full-history case positioned close to the 10% research grade boundary.
profiles.demo_intent: Show boundary-aware manual review without changing the probability.

profiles.label: Partial history · blended model
profiles.description: Three source families activate the frozen 75% history / 25% application blend.
profiles.demo_intent: Show validated model disagreement and data-limited routing.

profiles.label: Thin file · zero sources
profiles.description: No historical source family is available for this applicant.
profiles.demo_intent: Show visible uncertainty and mandatory data-limited review.

profiles.label: High risk · escalated review
profiles.description: High repayment-difficulty probability with otherwise complete history.
profiles.demo_intent: Show adverse evidence without presenting an autonomous decline.

profiles.label: Affordability stress · what-if
profiles.description: The strong applicant with annual proposed repayment increased to 60,750.
profiles.demo_intent: Show that affordability can change while historical risk evidence remains separate.

profiles.label: Feature-store outage · fail closed
profiles.description: A controlled simulation in which the historical feature-store row is unavailable.
profiles.demo_intent: Show explicit pipeline-quality flags and fail-closed review routing.
